title: Hearing Bunk Johnson and Emanuel Perez
summary: He barely remembers Bunk Johnson but knew his records; he heard Perez often on parades and at the roof garden.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. Anyway, uh, I was wondering about, uh, you mentioned hearing Bunk before we started. When, when, and where did you hear Bunk Johnson? Do you remember?

Well, I couldn't remember Bunk so good, but I, I heard talk of him. I heard a lot of his records. But I couldn't remember him so good. See, he didn't stay around yet too much. No, that's right. No. He was around, uh, New Iberia and places. But, uh, I heard a lot of his records.
Uh, where did you, did you ever hear Emmanuel Perez?

Oh yeah, lots of time. Oh, Emmanuel Perez was a powerful trumpet player. Lots of time I heard him on the roof garden, different place on parade. Oh, a lot of the musicians I know, the older fellas, a lot of the young ones I know.
